component.name: STRAWS
component.summary: Design, model and optimise wire antennas

description.p: STRAWS is a fast NEC-2 antenna modeller. Draw antennas in 3D or start from a template, sweep them live, and see radiation patterns, SWR, impedance and Smith charts. It tunes designs with an optimiser, designs matching networks and phased-array feeds, and opens 4nec2 decks.
